# Forage Norway

> A free guide to wild food in Norway: which wild plants are in season in each region and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 32 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/)

## Wild plants

- [Stinging nettle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/nettle/): Urtica dioica; Brennesle. In season April to July.
- [Wild garlic](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/wildgarlic/): Allium ursinum; Ramsløk. In season April to June.
- [Dandelion](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/dandelion/): Taraxacum officinale; Løvetann. In season April to September.
- [Ground elder](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/groundelder/): Aegopodium podagraria; Skvallerkål. In season May to July.
- [Chickweed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/chickweed/): Stellaria media; Vassarve. In season May to September.
- [Common sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/sorrel/): Rumex acetosa; Engsyre. In season May to August.
- [Wood sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/woodsorrel/): Oxalis acetosella; Gaukesyre. In season May to September.
- [Spruce tips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/spruce/): Picea abies; Granskudd. In season May to June.
- [Sea beet](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/seabeet/): Beta vulgaris subsp. maritima; Strandbete. In season May to September.
- [Dulse](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/dulse/): Palmaria palmata; Søl. In season April to September.
- [Sugar kelp](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/kelp/): Saccharina latissima; Sukkertare. In season March to June.
- [Blue mussels](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/mussel/): Mytilus edulis; Blåskjell. In season January to December.
- [Sweet woodruff](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/woodruff/): Galium odoratum; Myske. In season May to June.
- [Wild raspberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/raspberry/): Rubus idaeus; Bringebær. In season July to August.
- [Bilberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/bilberry/): Vaccinium myrtillus; Blåbær. In season July to September.
- [Lingonberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/lingonberry/): Vaccinium vitis-idaea; Tyttebær. In season August to October.
- [Cloudberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/cloudberry/): Rubus chamaemorus; Multe, Molte. In season July to August.
- [Wild strawberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/strawberry/): Fragaria vesca; Markjordbær. In season June to August.
- [Crowberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/crowberry/): Empetrum nigrum; Krekling. In season August to September.
- [Bog cranberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/cranberry/): Vaccinium oxycoccos; Tranebær. In season September to October.
- [Wild blackcurrant](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/blackcurrant/): Ribes nigrum; Solbær. In season July to August.
- [Rose hips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/rosehip/): Rosa canina; Nype. In season August to October.
- [Rowan berries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/rowan/): Sorbus aucuparia; Rogn. In season August to October.
- [Elderberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/elderberry/): Sambucus nigra; Svarthyll. In season August to September.
- [Elderflower](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/elderflower/): Sambucus nigra; Hylleblomst. In season June to July.
- [Sea buckthorn](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/seabuckthorn/): Hippophae rhamnoides; Tindved. In season August to October.
- [Juniper berries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/juniper/): Juniperus communis; Einer. In season September to November.
- [Hazelnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/hazelnut/): Corylus avellana; Hasselnøtt. In season August to September.
- [Meadowsweet](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/meadowsweet/): Filipendula ulmaria; Mjødurt. In season July to August.
- [Wild thyme](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/thyme/): Thymus serpyllum; Kryddertimian. In season June to August.
- [Yarrow](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/yarrow/): Achillea millefolium; Ryllik. In season June to September.
- [Red clover](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/redclover/): Trifolium pratense; Rødkløver. In season June to August.
- [Chanterelle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/chanterelle/): Cantharellus cibarius; Kantarell. In season July to September.
- [Porcini](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/porcini/): Boletus edulis; Steinsopp. In season July to September.
- [Giant puffball](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/puffball/): Calvatia gigantea; Kjempestøvball. In season July to September.
- [Chicken of the woods](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/chickenwoods/): Laetiporus sulphureus; Svovelkjuke. In season June to August.
- [Hedgehog mushroom](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/hedgehog/): Hydnum repandum; Piggsopp. In season August to October.
- [Cleavers](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/cleavers/): Galium aparine; Klengemaure. In season April to June.
- [White and red deadnettle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/deadnettle/): Lamium album; Tvetann. In season May to August.
- [Birch sap](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/birchsap/): Betula pendula; Bjørkesevje. In season April to May.
- [Bird cherry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/birdcherry/): Prunus padus; Hegg. In season August.
- [Beach rose](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/rugosa/): Rosa rugosa; Rynkerose. In season August to September.
- [Heather flowers](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/heather/): Calluna vulgaris; Røsslyng. In season July to September.
- [Bog myrtle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/bogmyrtle/): Myrica gale; Pors. In season June to August.
- [Scurvy grass](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/scurvygrass/): Cochlearia officinalis; Skjørbuksurt. In season May to July.
- [Sea rocket](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/searocket/): Cakile maritima; Strandreddik. In season June to August.
- [Sea plantain](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/seaplantain/): Plantago maritima; Strandkjempe. In season May to August.
- [Sea lettuce](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/sealettuce/): Ulva lactuca; Havsalat. In season May to September.
- [Arctic bramble](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/arcticbramble/): Rubus arcticus; Åkerbær. In season July to August.
- [Stone bramble](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/stonebramble/): Rubus saxatilis; Teiebær. In season July to August.
- [Iceland moss](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/icelandmoss/): Cetraria islandica; Islandslav. In season June to September.
- [Mountain sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/mountainsorrel/): Oxyria digyna; Fjellsyre. In season June to August.
- [Wild chives](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/wildchives/): Allium schoenoprasum; Grasløk. In season June to August.
- [Wild cherry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/wildcherry/): Prunus avium; Søtkirsebær. In season July.
- [Water mint](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/watermint/): Mentha aquatica; Vassmynte. In season June to August.
- [Wild marjoram](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/marjoram/): Origanum vulgare; Bergmynte. In season July to August.
- [Wild gooseberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/gooseberry/): Ribes uva-crispa; Stikkelsbær. In season July to August.
- [Periwinkles](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/periwinkle/): Littorina littorea; Strandsnegl. In season January to December.
- [Lamb's lettuce](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/lambslettuce/): Valerianella locusta; Lamb's lettuce. In season January to December.
- [Sea aster](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/seaaster/): Tripolium pannonicum; Strandstjerne. In season May to August.
- [Bistort](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/bistort/): Bistorta officinalis; Ormerot. In season May to June.
- [Sweet cicely](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/sweetcicely/): Myrrhis odorata; Spansk kjørvel. In season May to July.
- [Shepherd's purse](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/shepherdspurse/): Capsella bursa-pastoris; Gjetertaske. In season April to September.
- [Orache](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/orach/): Atriplex prostrata / A. patula; Melde. In season June to September.
- [Silverweed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/silverweed/): Argentina anserina; Gåsemure. In season September to November.
- [Horseradish](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/horseradish/): Armoracia rusticana; Pepperrot. In season September to November.
- [Garden angelica](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/angelica/): Angelica archangelica; Kvann. In season June to July.
- [Bladderwrack](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/bladderwrack/): Fucus vesiculosus; Blæretang. In season April to September.
- [Oysters](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/oyster/): Ostrea edulis / Magallana gigas; Østers. In season September to April.
- [Oyster mushroom](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/oystermush/): Pleurotus ostreatus; Østerssopp. In season September to November.
- [Horn of plenty](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/blacktrumpet/): Craterellus cornucopioides; Svart trompetsopp. In season August to October.
- [Shaggy inkcap](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/shaggymane/): Coprinus comatus; Matblekksopp. In season August to October.
- [Saffron milk cap](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/saffronmilkcap/): Lactarius deliciosus / L. deterrimus; Furumatriske. In season August to October.
- [Wood blewit](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/blewit/): Lepista nuda; Blåmusserong. In season September to November.
- [Morel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/morel/): Morchella spp.; Morkel. In season May to June.
- [Chaga](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/chaga/): Inonotus obliquus; Kjuke, Chaga. In season all year round.
- [Pineapple weed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/pineappleweed/): Matricaria discoidea; Tunbalderbrå. In season June to September.
- [White clover](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/whiteclover/): Trifolium repens; Kvitkløver. In season June to August.
- [Rosebay willowherb](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/plants/fireweed/): Chamerion angustifolium; Geitrams. In season May to August.

## Dishes

- [Blackcurrant cordial (solbærsaft)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/blackcurrant-cordial/): Blackcurrants cooked with sugar and strained, diluted hot in winter.
- [Crowberry juice (kreklingsaft)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/crowberry-juice/): Steam-juiced crowberries, often mixed with bilberry.
- [Elderflower cordial (hylleblomstsaft)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/elderflower-cordial/): Flowers steeped with lemon and citric acid, then sweetened.
- [Spruce tip syrup (granskuddsirup)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/spruce-tip-syrup/): Young spruce shoots simmered with sugar into a citrusy syrup.
- [Steamed mussels (blåskjell)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/steamed-mussels/): Mussels steamed with white wine, garlic and dill.
- [Dulse crisps (søl)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/dulse-crisps/): Dried dulse toasted in a dry pan until crisp.
- [Lingonberry jam (tyttebærsyltetøy)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/lingonberry-jam/): Lingonberries stirred raw with sugar, served with meatballs, game and potato.
- [Rowan jelly (rognebærgelé)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/rowan-jelly/): Rowan berries with apple, cooked and set for game.
- [Wild garlic butter (ramsløksmør)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/wild-garlic-butter/): Chopped ramsons in butter for fish and potatoes.
- [Juniper-cured game sauce](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/juniper-cured-game-sauce/): Crushed juniper and lingonberry in a cream sauce for elk or reindeer.
- [Nettle soup (nesle suppe)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/nettle-soup/): Young nettles in a creamy soup with a boiled egg.
- [Sugar kelp salad (sukkertare)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/sugar-kelp-salad/): Blanched kelp ribbons dressed with sesame and vinegar.
- [Bilberry muffins (blåbærmuffins)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/bilberry-muffins/): Muffins packed with forest bilberries.
- [Cloudberry cream (multekrem)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/cloudberry-cream/): Cloudberries folded into whipped cream; a Christmas dessert.
- [Bilberry soup (blåbærsuppe)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/bilberry-soup/): Warm bilberries thickened with potato starch.
- [Raspberry cream (bringebærkrem)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/raspberry-cream/): Crushed raspberries with whipped cream and sugar.
- [Rose hip soup (nypesuppe)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/rose-hip-soup/): Rose hip purée thickened into a sweet soup with cream.
- [Birch sap (bjørkesevje)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/birch-sap/): Fresh sap drunk chilled in April, lightly sweet and mineral.
- [Bird cherry juice (heggesaft)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/bird-cherry-juice/): Cooked bird cherries strained into a dark, almondy juice.
- [Rose hip tea (nypete)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/rose-hip-tea/): Dried rose hips simmered into tea.
- [Pickled sea plantain](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/pickled-sea-plantain/): Blanched strandkjempe in a sweet vinegar pickle with dill.
- [Rowan and apple chutney](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/rowan-and-apple-chutney/): Rowan berries with apple, onion and spice for game.
- [Wild chive butter (grasløksmør)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/wild-chive-butter/): Chopped wild chives in butter for fish and new potatoes.
- [Fish soup with sea lettuce](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/fish-soup-with-sea-lettuce/): Bergen-style creamy fish soup with mussels and crumbled sea lettuce.
- [Chanterelle sauce for reindeer](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/chanterelle-sauce-for-reindeer/): Chanterelles in cream with juniper, served with reindeer and lingonberries.
- [Porcini on toast (steinsopp)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/porcini-on-toast/): Sliced porcini fried in butter on toasted bread.
- [Iceland moss flatbread](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/iceland-moss-flatbread/): Leached and dried Iceland moss ground into flatbread dough, an old northern famine food.
- [Arctic bramble cream](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/arctic-bramble-cream/): Åkerbær folded into whipped cream.
- [Fried saffron milk caps (stekt matriske)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/fried-saffron-milk-caps/): Riske fried in butter on bread.
- [Angelica and fish (kvann)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/angelica-and-fish/): Young kvann stems cooked with fish, after Sámi and coastal tradition.
- [Chaga tea (kjuke-te)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/chaga-tea/): Chaga simmered for hours into tea.
- [Fireweed tea (geitrams-te)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/no/dishes/fireweed-tea/): Fermented fireweed leaves brewed as tea.
